items.body:
**Milestone:** M0 · **Wave:** M0-W2 · **Lane:** evidence · **Size:** M · **Trust-critical**

## Goal

Break the registry-test circle: the live run, the recorded evidence and the registry cell must agree, and a status flips only with evidence (I-14).

## Scope (projects / files)

apps/conformance/src/assert/three-way.ts; target conformance:test (--versions, --grep, --shard); tools/semantics-evidence (check on the PR diff); CODEOWNERS label lab-evidence

## Interfaces

CellResult {cellId, cfId, version, live, evidence, registry, verdict: pass|fail|unverified}

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given a PR changing a cell's effect or status without a matching evidence artefact, when semantics-evidence:check runs, then it fails; given a cell without a CF id, then audit-cells fails
- [ ] Given a live run that differs from the recorded evidence, when conformance:test runs, then it fails with a field-level diff

**Milestone:** M0 · **Wave:** M0-W2 · **Lane:** evidence · **Size:** M · **Trust-critical**

## Goal

Run the matrix on every PR (sharded) and nightly across runtimes and alphas, with mutation testing of the registry.

## Scope (projects / files)

## Interfaces

Required check 'conformance' when affected; nightly runs Node 26.12, Electron's Node (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE on the test-fused binary) and alphas that may fail and feed the 'unverified' state

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given a PR touching semantics, adapters or conformance, then 5 versions run on Node 24.22 in shards and block the merge on failure
- [ ] Given the nightly registry mutants (swap nack for reject; '>' to '>=' in isDoomed; drop a W-* gate), then each is killed by at least one test

## Verification

- `gh workflow run conformance-nightly.yml`
- `gh workflow run mutation-nightly.yml`

> Follow `gh workflow run …` with `gh run watch --exit-status` so the check actually waits for the result.

**Milestone:** M1 · **Wave:** M1-W2 · **Lane:** feature · **Size:** L · **Trust-critical**

items.title: [M3-P01] Linux packaging: deb/rpm with AppArmor, AppImage, x64 + arm64
items.body:
**Milestone:** M3 · **Wave:** M3-platform · **Lane:** platform · **Size:** M · **Trust-critical** · **Formerly:** M0-66 (Linux part)

## Goal

Signed and notarised macOS builds for arm64 and x64, and Linux packages that keep the sandbox (DC-58).

## Scope (projects / files)

electron-builder.release.yml mac section (dmg + zip arm64/x64, hardened runtime, notarize, NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription) and linux section (deb/rpm x64 + arm64 with AppArmor profile, AppImage)

## Interfaces

Targets desktop:package --platform=mac|linux and desktop:install-smoke

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given the macOS artefacts, then codesign --verify --deep --strict, spctl --assess and xcrun stapler validate pass for arm64 and x64
- [ ] Given the deb on ubuntu-24.04, then it installs the AppArmor profile and launches sandboxed, never with --no-sandbox

## Verification

- `pnpm nx run desktop:package --platform=mac --publish=never`
- `pnpm nx run desktop:package --platform=linux --publish=never`
- `pnpm nx run desktop:install-smoke --os=linux`

> **Re-sequenced (web-first):** Linux part of the design-phase M0-66; the macOS part is M4-P01.

## References

- Plan: docs/plan/plan.md · Amendments: docs/plan/amendments.md · Design WPs: docs/plan/work-packages-design.md · Blueprint: docs/architecture/blueprint.md
